offset_model: physical-ROM-byte-offset; half-open spans; exact ROM SHA-256 required
unknown: property mask zero means not proven; never means unused
merge: bitwise OR only after exact ROM, schema, contract, core, capability, and validation compatibility

properties.name: M68K_EXECUTED_ENCODING
properties.positive: completed instruction; decoder-exact encoding span; every byte resolves to this physical ROM

properties.name: Z80_EXECUTED_ENCODING
properties.positive: completed instruction; every prefix/opcode/operand byte has byte-exact ROM origin

properties.name: M68K_DATA_READ
properties.positive: completed data read resolved byte-by-byte to physical ROM

properties.name: Z80_DATA_READ
properties.positive: completed data read resolved through current bank mapping to physical ROM

properties.name: VDP_VRAM_SOURCE
properties.positive: exact ROM source bytes consumed by a successful transfer or by a completed same-instruction memory-source MOVE.W with exactly one byte-verified contiguous ROM-word read forwarded unchanged to an accepted Mode 5 VRAM data-port write

properties.name: VDP_CRAM_SOURCE
properties.positive: exact ROM source bytes consumed by a successful transfer or by a completed same-instruction memory-source MOVE.W with exactly one byte-verified contiguous ROM-word read forwarded unchanged to an accepted Mode 5 CRAM data-port write

properties.name: VDP_VSRAM_SOURCE
properties.positive: exact ROM source bytes consumed by a successful transfer or by a completed same-instruction memory-source MOVE.W with exactly one byte-verified contiguous ROM-word read forwarded unchanged to an accepted Mode 5 VSRAM data-port write

properties.name: AUDIO_PAYLOAD_PROVEN
properties.positive: a byte-exact banked-ROM read at verified Z80 Format-A mode-0 sample decoder sites 0x080E or 0x0855 inside the statically closed resources [0x0BC95C,0x0BD540) or [0x0BD540,0x0BF768); mark only the exact consumed byte
reject: reads outside the verified resource spans

properties.name: COMPRESSED_GRAPHICS_SOURCE
properties.positive: completed live call to exact M68K decoder entry 0x3820 with a ROM-backed A0 input; classify exactly the physical ROM bytes in [A0_entry,A0_return) after its RTS
reject: direct VRAM semantics inferred from compressed bytes

resolver: resolve every byte against active mapping; split at mapping changes; reject arithmetic overflow, handlers, and out-of-ROM spans

audio_consumer_contract.evidence: W5 deterministic decoder/inverse-encoder byte-identical round-trip and W4 live YM2612 DAC witness; only the exact runtime-read byte is classified

copy_origin: preserve origin only for explicitly supported byte-copy operations; unsupported writes or transformations clear origin
execution_origin: instruction fetch or prefetch alone does not prove execution; only completed decode contract may mark encoding

graphics_consumer_contract.extent: A0 at entry through A0 at successful RTS; exact consumed compressed input
graphics_consumer_contract.evidence: REVERSE_ENGINEERING.md verified decoder boundary and source-pointer postcondition; decoder has no nested call
